# Kidamame

> Kidamame is an independent, parent-founded studio creating calm, Montessori-inspired nature and science apps for children ages 4–10. Our apps operate 100% offline with zero ads, zero tracking, zero accounts required, and a single one-time purchase (no recurring subscriptions).

## Flagship App: Kidamame Discovery

- **Website**: [Kidamame Discovery](https://www.kidamame.com/discovery/)
- **Target Age**: Children ages 4–10 (and family co-play)
- **Platforms**: iOS, iPadOS, and Android
- **Pricing Model**: Free to try, with a single one-time in-app purchase to unlock forever (no monthly or annual subscriptions)
- **Offline Capability**: 100% offline (all content included on install; works in Airplane Mode for flights and road trips)
- **Privacy**: Zero ads, zero data tracking, zero third-party analytics, and no user account or login required
- **Languages Supported (6)**: English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, and Portuguese
- **Educational Content**:
  - 6 hand-illustrated natural biomes: The Alps, African Savannah, Australian Outback, The Arctic, Sonoran Desert, and Amazon Rainforest
  - 120+ interactive animals, plants, and geological/weather phenomena with authentic wildlife sounds and gentle animations
  - ~400 illustrated "Did You Know?" science and nature facts designed for curious kids and parents
  - Low-stimulation, Montessori-aligned design: no timers, no points, no coins, no noisy pop-ups, and no right-or-wrong grading

## Main Pages

- [Kidamame Home](https://www.kidamame.com/): Studio mission, the Kidamame Promise (No Ads, No Tracking, No Subscriptions), and family values.
- [Kidamame Discovery](https://www.kidamame.com/discovery/): Full overview of the 6 biomes, features, multilingual support, and FAQ.
- [Parenting & Mindful Screen Time Guides](https://www.kidamame.com/guides/): Practical guides comparing calm, educational, offline, and privacy-first apps for children.
- [Press Kit](https://www.kidamame.com/press-kit/): Official fact sheet, high-resolution screenshots, app icons, and media assets.
